description_zh: Waymo AV 直行时，对向车辆撞飞的手推车抛射至本车道导致碰撞，碰撞对象为非标准道路使用者（手推车），无直接车辆间交互，属于 Hit Object 类型，不在当前 DSL 覆盖范围内。
reason: 碰撞对象为手推车（hand truck dolly），非车辆/行人/骑行者/静态障碍物，且无直接车辆间交互，属于可辩护排除的 out-of-scope 类型。

source_snippets: an oncoming vehicle in the northbound lane struck a hand truck dolly, which was then projected from the northbound lane through the median lane and into the southbound lane occupied by the Waymo AV.
